verdict.rationale: Datalab publishes detailed API reference pages (convert-document, extract-structured-data, segment-document, create-document, run-document-agent, etc.) and offers a separate 'Forge' playground where users can upload documents and see results instantly without an API key, giving some interactive/try-it-now experience. However, a probe for a standard OpenAPI/Swagger spec (which typically powers runnable 'try it' examples embedded directly in API reference pages) returned 404s across all candidate paths, and no evidence shows executable code samples or a live 'run this request' widget within the API reference itself. Missing for 10: an OpenAPI/Swagger spec or embedded runnable request builder directly in the API reference docs, and confirmation that Forge is linked/integrated with the reference pages rather than a separate playground.
